biotools.summary: TaxTriage is an open-source metagenomic sequencing data analysis pipeline designed to identify putative pathogens from both short and long-read DNA and RNA sequencing data. It utilizes read classification, mapping, and de novo assembly, and is flexible with various installation options including cloud deployment via NF Tower and local installations.
biotools.name: TaxTriage
